'''Clue scroll (easy)''' is a [[cryptic clue]] obtained from [[Clue scroll (easy)|easy]] [[Treasure Trails]].

==Clue info==
{{Clue info
|id = 849
|text = The cryptic reveals where to dig:<br><br>Dig by the Giant's Den entrance, looking out over Lake Molch.
|notes = Dig near the south-east of [[Lake Molch]] in [[Zeah]], outside the [[Giants' Den]] cave entrance.
|map = {{Map|1418,3591|mtype=pin|plane=0|mapID=-1}}
}}

==Transportation==
*[[Lovakengj Minecart Network]] to Shayzien West.
*[[Fairy ring]] {{fairycode|djr}} and run south-west.
*[[Kharedst's memoirs]] or [[Book of the Dead]] teleport with [[History and Hearsay]].
*[[Xeric's talisman]] to [[Xeric's Lookout]].
*[[Rada's blessing]] teleport to the [[Kourend Woodland]] and run north-west.
*[[Kourend Castle Teleport]] and run south-west to [[Shayzien]].
